jobs.description: Amazon Now is India's fastest-growing Quick Commerce offering, delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We are on a mission to expand to 300+ cities and become the most loved quick commerce destination for millions of customers. To achieve this, we are building world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless under-the-roof operations across our partner network. We are looking for a passionate and experienced Software Development Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team that owns the technology powering store operations and grocery partner experiences. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you will build systems that directly fuel Amazon's rapid Quick Commerce expansion — a flagship S-Team goal. Key job responsibilities 1. Own the end-to-end technology stack for store launches, enabling rapid onboarding of new partner stores across cities at unprecedented speed and scale 2. Build and evolve catalog and selection management systems — curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the seller experience for listing new items 3. Drive Under-the-Roof (UTR) technology — powering inventory management, picking, staging, and store operations workflows 4. Lead architecture decisions for systems that must scale reliably across hundreds of stores while maintaining sub-minute operational latencies 5. Recruit, mentor, and grow a team of SDEs fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and operational excellence 6. Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous business problems into crisp technical solutions 7. Establish engineering best practices, drive operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), and maintain a high quality bar A day in the life You start your day reviewing key operational metrics and ensuring systems are healthy across all live stores. You join a standup with your team to unblock engineers, review design documents, and prioritize the sprint backlog. Mid-morning, you collaborate with product and operations partners to define requirements for the next wave of store launches. After lunch, you dive into a system design review for a new catalog ingestion pipeline, providing technical guidance and challenging assumptions. Later, you conduct a 1:1 with a team member to discuss career growth and align on stretch goals. You wrap up by reviewing a deployment plan for a feature that will go live across multiple cities this week — ensuring rollback strategies and monitoring are in place. About the team We are part of Amazon Now (Tez), Amazon's Quick Commerce business in India. Our team builds the technology that powers how partner stores operate — from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving complex problems in real-time inventory management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work directly impacts millions of customers who rely on us for their everyday essentials delivered in minutes. We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. Our team puts a high value on work-life balance and offers flexibility in working hours. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor.

jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Roles and Responsibilities Customer Engagement Measurement & Analytics Delivery Independently delivered measurement analyses assessing the effectiveness of omnichannel customer engagement across field, CRM, paid media, owned digital, and third-party channels. Apply machine learning techniques to identify patterns in customer engagement, channel synergy, sequencing, pacing, and message performance. Support the development and operationalization of measurement frameworks, KPI tracking tools, and performance dashboards aligned with the team's strategic priorities. Synthesize analytical findings into clear, structured outputs and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders and team leads. Experimentation & Test-and-Learn Support Support the design and execution of AI-informed test-and-learn strategies , including A/B tests, lift studies, and incrementality experiments across customer engagement tactics. Assist in defining success metrics, measurement windows, and statistical approaches to evaluate new engagement strategies. Contribute to the documentation and socialization of experimental learnings to inform ongoing campaign planning across brands. Help refine experimentation frameworks to accelerate learning cycles and improve engagement effectiveness. Advanced Analytics & Attribution Apply advanced statistical and AI/ML techniques to measure the incremental impact of customer engagement activities. Support the use of attribution frameworks such as multi-touch attribution, Markov chain modelling, and causal inference methods (e.g., propensity scoring, matched control). Contribute to the integration of outputs from MMx, KDA, and predictive models to support engagement optimization strategies. Leverage automation to improve speed, consistency, and repeatability of insights delivery. Stakeholder Partnership & Communication Partner with US Commercial stakeholders, Brand, Omnichannel Strategy, Field Analytics, CRM, Digital, and Technology teams to contribute to AI-enabled measurement solution design. Clearly communicate measurement methodologies, assumptions, model limitations, and implications for decision-making to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to stakeholder presentations and working sessions with structured, insight-driven storytelling focused on impact and commercial actions. Team Collaboration & Capability Building Collaborate within cross-functional and global teams to ensure consistent, scalable, and governed analytical delivery aligned with AI best practices. Mentor junior analysts on advanced measurement methodologies, analytical rigor, and responsible data usage. Contribute to the development of reusable analytics frameworks, measurement templates, and best practices that scale across brands. Promote high standards of reproducibility and documentation across all team deliverables. Technical Execution & Data Stewardship Build and maintain AI-enabled measurement datasets, dashboards, and automated workflows supporting omnichannel engagement analytics. Work closely with data engineering, technology, and build teams to troubleshoot data issues and provide measurement-driven feedback to enhance commercial solutions. Ensure analytical outputs are reproducible, well-documented, and aligned with data governance, compliance, and responsible use standards. Skills & Competencies Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex analytics and engagement insights into clear business outcomes, including AI-generated findings. Solid project execution and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams in parallel. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail, data quality, and measurement rigor. Hands-on expertise in applied statistics, analytics, and advanced measurement concepts relevant to omnichannel performance. Familiarity with HCP and patient engagement journeys across digital, field, and media channels. Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed, stakeholder-driven environment. Curiosity and passion for learning, innovation, and continuous improvement in analytics and measurement. Experience & Qualifications BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred in data science, analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, life sciences, computer science, or engineering. 3–5 years of professional experience in advanced analytics, decision science, or omnichannel engagement measurement roles, ideally within an AI-driven commercial environment. Proven experience delivering end-to-end analytics and measurement projects, from problem framing to insight delivery. Experience with attribution and impact measurement techniques (e.g., multi-touch attribution, causal inference, uplift modeling) is a strong plus. Demonstrated ability to partner with business stakeholders and support data-informed decision-making. Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industries preferred. Proficiency in Python or R for analytical modeling and data transformation. Experience with cloud-based analytics environments (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) preferred. We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As the Director of Site Operations, you’ll own node and rack uptime for SpaceXAI's AI supercompute cluster—the most advanced of its kind. This role is the extreme owner of cluster health and customer Service Level Agreements across 5+ sites operating 24/7. You’ll lead a 250+ person organization of site managers, shift supervisors, and technicians, plus the site reliability engineering team that monitors cluster health and drives fault mitigation at scale. We’re looking for a hands-on operations leader who can build a culture of excellence and accountability, partner tightly across the company, and keep uptime exceptional as we grow.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own Cluster Uptime: Serve as extreme owner of node, rack, and cluster health across 5+ sites running 24/7, accountable for customer Service Level Agreements and consistently exceptional uptime on SpaceXAI's supercompute cluster.
Lead a Large Operations Organization: Direct a 250+ person team spanning site managers, shift supervisors, and technicians across four 24/7 shifts, building a culture of excellence and accountability at every layer of the org.
Drive Node and Rack Remediation: Ensure systematic recovery of failed nodes and racks through command-line and physical intervention, driving mean time to repair to the feasible minimum.
Partner Across Functions: Coordinate with facilities operations to limit downtime from power and cooling faults and proactive maintenance; with network engineering on cluster upgrades; and with tenant representatives on node remediation and planned and unplanned downtime.
Own Vendor Execution: Direct vendors through hardware rework and field operations so repairs, replacements, and capacity work happen at the speed the cluster requires.
Lead Site Reliability Engineering: Own the SRE organization responsible for proactive cluster health monitoring, reactive fault mitigation at scale, root cause analyses for node, rack, and cluster issues, and site-wide reliability procedures and fault documentation.
Run Data-Driven Improvement: Lead continual improvement and efficiency initiatives, using operational data to balance team resources and raise uptime, repair time, and SLA performance across sites.
Command Incidents at Scale: Set the standard for incident response during cluster-impacting events, providing clear direction, fast recovery, and tight communication with internal and external partners.
Scale Operations: Standardize best practices across sites and grow the organization in step with cluster expansion, keeping operations consistent as SpaceXAI's footprint scales.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of experience working in a large scale operations with 5+ years leading people leaders of technical teams OR 10+ years of experience working in a large scale operations with 5+ years leading people leaders of technical teams.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Proven ability to lead large, multi-site, 24/7 operations organizations in fast-paced, high-responsibility settings.
Deep expertise in server hardware, cluster reliability, and data center technologies, from deployment through lifecycle management.
Experience supporting compute-heavy environments like AI, machine learning, or high-performance computing at scale.
A track record of owning uptime, Service Level Agreements, or reliability metrics for large compute clusters.
Experience leading site reliability engineering or equivalent reliability-focused teams, including root cause analysis and procedure ownership.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from technicians to executive and tenant partners.
A history of partnering with vendors at scale, driving mean time to repair down, and scaling operations across multiple sites.
Familiarity with tooling and automation (e.g., Jira, Python, Bash) used to monitor cluster health and improve team efficiency.
Enthusiasm for SpaceXAI's mission to accelerate human discovery and unravel the universe.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, mission-focused environment with on-call ownership of cluster-impacting events.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Willingness to travel frequently to data center locations to support operations across sites.
Physical capability to handle data center tasks, including lifting up to 50 lbs unassisted, standing for long periods, and occasional ladder use.
Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - 8+ years of industry experience & knowledge of semiconductor package reliability principles and failure mechanisms, including electromigration, solder-joint fatigue, interfacial delamination, dielectric cracking, via failure, warpage, creep, stress relaxation, and material degradation. - In-depth knowledge of advanced packaging architectures, including 2.5D and 3.5D integration, interposers, embedded bridges, chiplets, large package substrates, HBM integration, redistribution layers, and package-level power delivery. - Demonstrated experience leading package failure investigations, performing root-cause analysis, and implementing effective design, material, process, or manufacturing corrective actions. - Strong experience with thermal and mechanical finite-element modeling of packages, including temperature distribution, warpage, stress, strain, fatigue, and interfacial reliability. - Strong understanding of package-material behavior, including coefficient of thermal expansion, elasticity, viscoelasticity, plasticity, creep, adhesion, fracture toughness, thermal conductivity, and temperature-dependent properties. 회사 소개
쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.

합니다. 이를 기반으로 매끄러운 온보딩 경험을 제공하고 긴밀한 브랜드 파트너십을 관리하여 장기적인 비즈니스 시너지를 창출합니다. 우리는 데이터를 기반으로 타깃을 명확히 하고, 확실한 컨버전(Conversion)을 만들어내는 실행력 중심의 팀입니다.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
우리는 주어진 역할을 넘어 과감한 실행력을 지향합니다. 쿠팡 리테일은 로켓배송의 압도적인 성장을 실질적인 비즈니스 성과로 창출해 나가고 있는 핵심 조직입니다. 쿠팡 리테일에서는 카테고리 전략과 수익구조를 직접 설계하며 유통 산업의 새로운 표준을 정립합니다. 데이터와 고객 중심 사고로 성장을 견인할 시니어/리드급 인재에게 쿠팡은 커리어 확장의 최고 무대가 될 것입니다. 정해진 답을 따르기 보다 과감한 시도로 성과를 증명해 온 분이라면, 로켓배송과 함께 그 가치를 더 크게 키워 보시기 바랍니다.
로켓배송은?
로켓배송은 세계적 수준의 압도적인 기술과 물류 인프라를 바탕으로 오늘 주문하면 내일 도착하는 쿠팡의 핵심 서비스입니다. 상품의 직접 매입부터 보관, 배송, 반품까지 전 과정을 쿠팡이 책임지는 End-to-End 방식입니다.
주요 업무
글로벌 브랜드, 총판 및 병행수입 업체를 발굴하고 신규 상품 소싱 전략을 수립하여 카테고리 성장을 주도

jobs.description: Where Ambition Meets Innovation Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. Behind every high-performing leadership team is someone who makes excellence look effortless. This is that role. Job Overview: We are seeking an Executive Administrative Assistant to provide primary support to the Executive Vice President, Chief Talent Officer, while also providing full administrative support to selected Senior Vice Presidents across the People Leadership Team. This highly visible role creates leverage for senior leaders by protecting their time, strengthening coordination, and keeping important commitments moving. More than traditional administrative support, this role serves as the “oil in the engine” of the People Leadership Team: keeping priorities aligned, routines running seamlessly, and ensuring no critical detail is overlooked. You will understand leaders’ priorities, teams, operating rhythms, and business objectives and use that context to anticipate needs, manage complex logistics and communications, and help the team move with clarity and confidence. You will be a trusted partner to senior leaders: exercising sound judgment, handling highly confidential information with discretion, anticipating what is coming, and spotting conflicts or dependencies before they become blockers. In a fast-moving environment with competing priorities, you will create the structure, and follow-through leaders need to operate at their best. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves bringing order to complexity, and takes pride in being the person others count on when excellence matters most. Responsibilities: Provide comprehensive executive administrative support to the EVP and selected SVPs, including complex calendar management, domestic & international travel coordination, Concur travel and expense management, meeting planning, and day-to-day executive support. Protect and prioritize executive time by evaluating requests against leadership priorities, anticipating conflicts and dependencies, and proactively resolving, redirecting, or escalating issues before they become blockers. Coordinate leadership meetings, offsites, town halls, team events, and other high-impact activities, including agendas, logistics, preparation, materials, and follow-through. Draft, edit, and produce presentations, executive communications, agendas, reports, and meeting materials. Track commitments and action items, coordinate follow-up, and surface stalled items or dependencies requiring leadership attention. Serve as a trusted point of coordination across leaders, partners, and internal and external stakeholders, ensuring requests and information reach the right people. Partner closely with other Executive Assistants and Administrative Assistants to coordinate leadership activities, provide seamless coverage, and strengthen administrative practices such as coverage plans, executive-preference documentation, delegation norms, and shared systems. Exercise exceptional judgment and discretion when navigating competing priorities, complex situations, and sensitive information. Identify repetitive or inefficient administrative workflows and explore Microsoft tools, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that reduce friction and improve efficiency. Deliver thoughtful, professional experiences for employees, candidates, leaders, and business partners while maintaining a consistently high standard of accuracy and attention to detail. What are we looking for? We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness , act with integrity , and are driven to help our clients succeed . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. You see around corners and act before problems arise. You bring calm, momentum, and sound judgment to a fast-moving environment, protecting executive time by making thoughtful tradeoffs, redirecting requests when needed, and speaking up when something needs attention. When priorities shift, you stay resourceful, steady, and focused on what matters most. You are collaborative, team-first, and just as comfortable working independently. You build trust quickly, communicate with clarity and warmth, and navigate sensitive situations with maturity and discretion. You also enjoy partnering with other administrative professionals to help the broader team operate at its best. You are curious about better ways of working. You are eager to learn, think critically, and explore tools that eliminate repetitive work. Most importantly, you take ownership, bring a positive attitude and sense of humor, and genuinely enjoy helping great leaders and teams succeed. Requirements: 6+ years of Executive Assistant or Executive Administrative Assistant experience supporting senior leaders. Demonstrated experience providing primary support to an EVP or C-suite executive while supporting multiple senior leaders in a highly visible, fast-paced, or complex environment. Proven ability to manage complex and frequently changing calendars while prioritizing competing requests and aligning executive time to the highest-impact work. Experience coordinating complex domestic and international travel, meetings, events, expenses, and executive planning. Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills with strong attention to detail and follow-through. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive communications, presentations, agendas, reports, and meeting materials. Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills and comfort coordinating across multiple teams, levels, and administrative partners. Excellent judgment and a demonstrated ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential information with discretion. Advanced proficiency in Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications. A positive attitude, sense of humor, collaborative mindset, and genuine commitment to helping others succeed. Core Competencies: Create meaningful executive capacity by protecting senior leaders’ time and enabling them to focus on their highest-value work. Serve as the "oil in the engine" of the People Leadership Team, keeping priorities aligned, commitments moving, and critical details covered. Improve leadership effectiveness through disciplined prioritization, thoughtful preparation, clear communication, and dependable follow-through. Drive seamless execution of executive travel, leadership meetings, team events, offsites, and other high-priority activities. Safeguard highly confidential information with exceptional judgment, professionalism, and discretion. Identify conflicts, dependencies, and stalled commitments early so leaders can address them before they disrupt execution. Build strong relationships across the organization and earn a reputation as a trusted partner. Elevate the experience of employees, candidates, business partners, and visitors through thoughtful execution and attention to detail. Contribute to a culture that reflects LPL's values of Pursue Greatness, Do the Right Thing, Drive Our Clients' Success, Win Together, and Create & Share Joy. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! Company Overview: LPL Financial Holdings Inc. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. you'll

The Game Security team is responsible for protecting our players, our games, and intellectual property from malicious actors.
We work across multiple disciplines to detect, deter, and disrupt threats impacting the player experience.
We work closely with other teams to enforce, support, and improve security solutions.

Analyze and respond to threats including cheats, exploits, account takeovers, and intellectual property (IP) abuse.

Investigate security incidents, analyze telemetry, and recommend mitigations related to cheating and fraud.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve security controls and detection.
Monitor cheat trends, automate detection and enforcement workflows, and enhance account security posture.

3+ years professional experience in security analysis, game security, or threat detection.
Proven experience analyzing cheats, game exploits, abuse vectors, and IP infringement cases.
Familiarity with anti-cheat systems, abuse prevention, and account takeover mitigation.
Understanding of account security threats, including credential stuffing and account takeovers.
Strong analytical mind with problem-solving skills.
Proficient in log analysis, threat hunting, and security automation.
Familiarity with security assessment tools and monitoring systems.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.
Ability to stay updated on emerging cheat methods, security vulnerabilities, and gaming industry threats.
PLUSES
Please note that these are desirable skills and are not required to apply for the position.
Experience working with online games, live services, or large-scale AAA multiplayer environments.
Knowledge of credential stuffing and bot mitigation.
Scripting skills (e.g. SQL, Python) for automation and analysis.
Experience with rigorous documentation requirements (e.g. investigations, analysis, evidentiary records, etc.).
Knowledge of machine learning approaches for cheat and bot detection.

AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.
[Team 비전]
저희 팀은 특화 모델(Specialized Model) 을 개발합니다. 많은 기업이 반복되는 고정 업무에 frontier 모델 API를 사용하지만, 실제로 필요한 것은 범용 능력의 일부임에도 매 호출마다 범용성 전체에 대한 비용을 지불하게 됩니다. 저희는 오픈소스 파운데이션 모델을 특정 업무에 맞게 빠르게 finetuning하여,
특화 모델 개발 영역에서는 frontier 모델을 기준으로 타겟 업무의 품질·비용 기준을 수립하고, 다양한 규모의 오픈소스 모델을 평가하여 개발에 적합한 모델을 선정합니다. 이후 모델을 타겟 업무에 맞게 고도화하여 frontier 수준의 성능과 높은 비용 효율성을 동시에 달성합니다.
평가 체계 영역에서는 특화 모델의 품질을 신뢰할 수 있게 측정하는 방법론을 설계합니다. Human gold label 기반 정량 지표, LLM-judge 기반 pairwise 비교, 결함 포착률 분석 등 업무 특성에 맞는 평가 프로토콜을 구축하고, 정량 평가와 정성 감사를 결합해 배포 판단의 근거를 만듭니다.
또한 이러한 과정을 자동화된 파이프라인으로 발전시키는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.
새로 합류하시는 분께서는 모델 증류와 finetuning, LLM 평가 등 특화 모델 개발의 전 과정을 함께 추진하며, AI 기술의 실질적인 비즈니스 가치를 만들어가게 됩니다.
우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.
